title: 電磁祭囃子 in NEO TOKYO 🏮
summary: A short music video by the Japanese group Electronicos Fantasticos, led by Ei Wada, playing festival-style music on repurposed old electronics. Instruments include CRT TVs, a barcode reader, an electric fan harp and TV taiko drums.
why: HN users share it as a delightful example of people making real music from obsolete electronics and self-built instruments.

quote.text: It's this band from Japan who make incredible music with instruments they made themselves.
